Banner.name: hotspots
Banner.description: Clickable SVG image-map regions (rect/oval/polygon) overlaid on the media, each linking to a URL or deeplink. Renders as a real SVG shape (not clip-path), with a separately-sized keyboard-focusable hit target per hotspot

Banner.name: config.hotspotMinTargetSize
Banner.description: Minimum hotspot hit-target size in CSS px, enforced independently of the drawn shape size (WCAG 2.5.8). Default: 24

Banner.name: config.backgroundEffect
Banner.description: Animated canvas layer rendered behind the media/overlay. Shared plugin engine (src/utils/backgroundEffects.ts) also used by SlidingBanner — new effects can be added there without touching this component. 'rain'/'thunderstorm' include a water band along the bottom edge with landing ripples; 'thunderstorm' additionally adds periodic lightning flashes/bolts. 'fog' is winter fog drifting with wind, light snow, plus cinematic frost shards. 'autumn' is falling, swaying autumn leaves. 'festival' is an Indian-festival (Diwali-style) look with ambient diya sparkle and periodic firework bursts. 'santa' has twinkling string lights, snowfall mixed with tumbling candy canes and peppermints, a galloping-reindeer sleigh flyby (with a glowing Rudolph nose leading) that drops a trail of tumbling candy canes and mints as it flies, loops back right-to-left through the bottom half of the frame after its first pass instead of just vanishing, and a playful Santa cap that randomly peeks in and out from one of the four frame edges like hide-and-seek. 'sea' is an aerial-view waterline wash — the effect stays transparent everywhere except a thin translucent, sea-tinted band (~10% of the banner height) along the bottom edge, so the banner's own background image reads as the seashore/beach itself. The band breathes in and out on a natural (non-mechanical) surge rhythm, with drifting aerial-style foam blobs and lacy filament streaks, like a top-down drone shot of waves lapping the sand. Default: 'none'

Banner.name: lazyLoad
Banner.description: Defer mounting media/hotspots until the banner scrolls near the viewport (default: true)

TimerWidget.name: targetDate
TimerWidget.description: ISO 8601 date-time string; the countdown ticks towards this date

TimerWidget.name: title
TimerWidget.description: Optional heading displayed above the timer blocks

TimerWidget.name: variant
TimerWidget.description: Visual color theme for the timer blocks (default: 'dark')

TimerWidget.name: backgroundImageUrl
TimerWidget.description: Background image URL. When set, renders behind the widget with a readability overlay so timer blocks stay legible over photos

TimerWidget.name: backgroundPosition
TimerWidget.description: CSS background-position for the background image (default: 'center')

TimerWidget.name: overlay
TimerWidget.description: CSS background for the scrim over the background image, e.g. a gradient or rgba() color (default: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)')

TimerWidget.name: expiredText
TimerWidget.description: Message shown once targetDate has passed, in place of the countdown blocks

TimerWidget.name: width
TimerWidget.description: CSS width for the root element (default: 'auto')

TimerWidget.name: height
TimerWidget.description: CSS height for the root element (default: 'auto'). When 'auto' and backgroundImageUrl is set, the widget's height follows the image's natural aspect ratio via an in-flow . Pass an explicit value (e.g. '320px') to pin the height instead — the CMS admin computes and saves this from the image so the public page can reserve the space up front and avoid layout shift

TimerWidget.name: className
TimerWidget.description: Additional CSS class names on the root element

TimerWidget.name: lazyLoad
TimerWidget.description: Defer starting the countdown interval until scrolled near the viewport (default: true)
